{{Quote|They've found team 102, all dead. Two were killed by blaster fire; the other two&hellip; There seems to be some confusion about the other two.|A [[Unidentified Stormtrooper commander (Chimeara)|Stormtrooper commander]]|<ref name="DFR" />}}
'''Team 102''' was a group of four [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] on board the [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']] that were assigned to locate [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]. They were [[Death/Legends|dead]] when Luke, Mara, and [[Talon Karrde]] escaped from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]].<ref name="DFR" />
